text:
Predicates:
SupervisedLearning(x) ::: x is supervised learning.
UnsupervisedLearning(x) ::: x is unsupervised learning.
ReinforcementLearning(x) ::: x is reinforcement learning.
RequiresLabelledData(x) ::: x requires labelled data.
TrainedWith(x, y) ::: x is trained with y.
StateOfTheArtTextSummarizationModel(x) ::: x is the state-of-the-art text summarization model.

Premises:
SupervisedLearning(MLAlgorithms) ∧ UnsupervisedLearning(MLAlgorithms) ∧ ReinforcementLearning(MLAlgorithms) ::: Machine Learning algorithms can be categorized as supervised learning, unsupervised learning, and reinforcement learning.
∀x (UnsupervisedLearning(x) → ¬RequiresLabelledData(x)) ::: Unsupervised learning doesn't require labelled data.
TrainedWith(StateOfTheArtTextSummarizationModel, MLAlgorithms) ::: The state-of-the-art text summarization model is trained with machine learning algorithms.
¬TrainedWith(StateOfTheArtTextSummarizationModel, ReinforcementLearning) ::: Reinforcement learning is not used to train the state-of-the-art text summarization model.
RequiresLabelledData(MLAlgorithmForTextSummarization) ::: The Machine Learning algorithm for training text summarization model requires labelled data.

Conclusion:
TrainedWith(StateOfTheArtTextSummarizationModel, SupervisedLearning) ::: Supervised learning is used to train the state-of-the-art text summarization model.
